typography.strategy: Bold, punchy, oversized headings with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to create a lively street-food aesthetic. Body text should be geometric, friendly, and highly readable.

colors.strategy: High contrast and vibrant. Warm off-white background with dopamine-inducing accent blocks in Coral Pink (primary), Ocean Blue (secondary), and Lemon Yellow (accent).
colors.rules: Avoid generic gradients. Rely on high-saturation flat colors.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard 4px or 8px solid shadows (neo-brutalist touch) for interactive elements and bento cards to give it a raw, youthful street food vibe.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on colored containers to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 2px solid dark borders (#0A192F) on bento cards and buttons to make the vibrant colors pop.

layouts.strategy: Hero-first layout with full-bleed imagery and massive typography. The 'Bento' Grid Protocol (Mode A: The Tetris Grid) for the Menu/Products section to create asymmetry and visual tension.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 for bento cards, py-24 for main vertical sections.

sections.name: Header & Nav
sections.description: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/80). Includes Logo, Nav Links, Language Switcher (IT/EN), and a vibrant pill-shaped 'Ordina Ora / Order Now' CTA.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Massive 'Bebas Neue' typography overlaid on a mouth-watering fish burger or poke bowl image. High contrast overlay to ensure text readability. Floating call-to-action for Take Away with a phone icon.

sections.name: Chi Siamo (About)
sections.description: Asymmetrical layout. Large text block explaining the Kalama philosophy (fresh fish, fast food speed) on one side, candid lively restaurant photo on the other.

sections.name: Servizi/Prodotti (Menu)
sections.description: Bento grid (Tetris Grid). Showcasing categories: Poke Bowls, Fish Burgers, Fried Fish, and Seafood. Cards should have solid dark borders and vibrant backgrounds on hover.

sections.name: Franchising
sections.description: High energy section with a solid Ocean Blue (#0055FF) background. Text in Lemon Yellow and White. Includes an inquiry form using Shadcn components.

sections.name: Galleria Foto (Gallery)
sections.description: A continuous scrolling marquee of vibrant food and restaurant lifestyle images. Use framer-motion or react-fast-marquee.

sections.name: Modulo di Contatto & Footer
sections.description: Shadcn contact form side-by-side with location/take-away details. Massive Footer typography for the brand name.

hero.description: Delicious salmon sandwich with pickled onions

menu.description: Vibrant poke bowl on dark background

gallery_and_about.description: Busy street food market at night

motion.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium weight.
motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons use slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansion. Staggered entrance animations for bento grid items.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a vibrant 'FRESH FISH • FAST FOOD • FRANCHISING' ticker.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Button, Checkbox. Customize borders to be 2px solid dark with slight shadow to match the dopamine/neo-brutalist theme.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70) with language switcher (Shadcn DropdownMenu for IT/EN). DO NOT use fully transparent headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Bebas Neue and Outfit fonts via Google Fonts.
Install lucide-react for icons (e.g., Phone, MapPin, Globe, Menu).
Install react-fast-marquee for the text ticker.
Install framer-motion for page transitions and scroll animations.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='lang-switcher', data-testid='franchise-submit-btn', data-testid='takeaway-call-btn').
Ensure multilingual support by wrapping text strings in a simple context or state (IT/EN) - default to IT since it is an Italian brand.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` for the language switcher, use Shadcn DropdownMenu.
Implement the Bento grid exactly as described: asymmetrical, varying heights, no empty generic columns.
DO NOT use generic Vercel-like styles; apply the vibrant colors, solid borders, and bold typography as defined.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
